ArtifactRefV1.description:
A reference to a stored artifact — never the raw bytes themselves.

Stages pass around pointers (path + hash + mime type). The actual file
lives in the object store (S3-compatible); the manifest / envelope only
ever stores the reference.

path.description: Content-addressed storage path/key for the artifact, e.g. 's3://bucket/artifacts/<sha256>.mp4'. Must not be a mutable alias such as 'latest.mp4'.
path.title: Path

hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the artifact contents.
hash.title: Hash

mime_type.description: MIME type of the stored artifact, e.g. 'video/mp4', 'audio/wav', 'application/json'.
mime_type.title: Mime Type

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when this artifact reference was created.
created_at.title: Created At

description:
Generic parent model for every stage's output.

Deliberately generic today, per the runbook: this is NOT ScriptOutput,
VoiceOutput, or AvatarOutput. Every later stage-specific output will
extend this model rather than the pipeline inventing one-off shapes now.

payload.description: Stage-specific structured data. Kept generic (a dict) at this stage; concrete stage outputs will subclass this model later rather than redefining payload shape here.
payload.title: Payload

metadata.description: Non-payload contextual data about this output, e.g. timing, cost, or provider-specific notes.
metadata.title: Metadata

artifact_refs.description: References to any artifacts this stage produced.
artifact_refs.title: Artifact Refs

title: StageOutputV1
